meta.name: linkedin-content
meta.description: LinkedIn post writing with hook formulas, formatting rules, and engagement patterns. Covers post types, algorithm signals, character limits, and content pillars. Use for: LinkedIn posts, professional content, thought leadership, B2B content, personal branding. Triggers: linkedin post, linkedin content, linkedin writing, linkedin strategy, linkedin engagement, linkedin algorithm, linkedin hook, linkedin formatting, thought leadership, professional content, b2b content, linkedin growth

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高互动 LinkedIn 帖子，提升个人品牌影响力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要持续产出专业且有吸引力的 LinkedIn 内容
copy.tagline_en: Write high-engagement LinkedIn posts to boost your personal brand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to consistently produce professional and engaging LinkedIn content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你写 LinkedIn 帖子，包括钩子、正文、行动号召和话题标签，并遵循格式规则和算法信号。
howto.when: 当你提到“LinkedIn 帖子”、“LinkedIn 内容”等关键词，或要求写专业内容、思想领导力文章时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一条关于远程团队管理的 LinkedIn 帖子。
say.note: Claude 会生成带钩子和格式的完整帖子。

say.text: 给我一个反直觉的 LinkedIn 钩子例子。
say.note: Claude 会从钩子公式中选取一个示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write LinkedIn posts, including hooks, body, call-to-action, and hashtags, following formatting rules and algorithm signals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "LinkedIn post", "LinkedIn content", or ask for professional content or thought leadership.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn post about remote team management.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full post with hook and formatting.

say_en.text: Give me a contrarian LinkedIn hook example.
say_en.note: Claude will pick an example from the hook formulas.
